articles.summary: (NYSE: AEM) (TSX: AEM) ("Agnico Eagle") announced today that Avenir Minerals Limited ("Avenir"), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Agnico Eagle, acquired 666,667 units ("Units") of Canada Nickel Company Inc. ("Canada Nickel") at a price of C$1.50 per Unit for total consideration of C$1,000,000.50 pursuant to a non-brokered private placement (the "Private Placement").
